tools.name: doc_memory_status
tools.description: Show dmem mode (local/server), auth state, consent, vocabulary versions and search provider. Returns no secrets.

tools.name: doc_memory_recall
tools.description: Before writing or editing a document, slide deck or page, find saved templates, reference facts and style rules for this URL + form (doc_type, locale). Returns at most 3 untrusted hints.

tools.name: doc_memory_search
tools.description: Browse your library and, when allowed, team/public libraries by filters or text. Returns untrusted summaries with author, license and version.

tools.name: doc_memory_expand
tools.description: Open one memory. level 1 = summary and outline with author, license, version; level 2 = full structure, slots and rules. Pass version to pin an immutable version.

tools.name: doc_memory_web_search
tools.description: Find candidate web documents for a topic (needs a configured search provider). Returns URLs and snippets only; nothing is saved.

tools.name: doc_memory_web_preview
tools.description: Fetch one public https URL safely and preview its structure, license signals and size. Nothing is saved.

tools.name: doc_memory_save
tools.description: Save or update a template, reference or style rule in your private library from inline content or a preview. Secrets are rejected; personal data becomes slots.

tools.name: doc_memory_import
tools.description: Import a previewed or public web document into your private library with provenance. An unknown license keeps structure only.

tools.name: doc_memory_copy
tools.description: Copy a visible memory (yours, team or public) into your private library, keeping author, source version and license.

tools.name: doc_memory_publish
tools.description: Share a saved memory with team/public after explicit user consent, or set visibility=private to unpublish.

tools.name: doc_memory_delete
tools.description: Delete a memory and all of its versions. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: doc_memory_outcome
tools.description: Report whether recalled memory helped. Needs the receipt returned by recall (linked account only).

wrapper_tools.name: doc_memory_clip_current_tab
wrapper_tools.description: Clip the current browser tab (explicit user request only) into your private library with captured provenance.
